name: contact
description: Resend-backed contact form with lazy validation and reserved-height field hints
postInstall:
Drop <ContactSection /> into a page (e.g. `src/app/page.tsx`) or import <ContactForm /> directly.

RESEND_API_KEY is required. CONTACT_EMAIL_TO is the inbox you want messages delivered to. CONTACT_EMAIL_FROM defaults to onboarding@resend.dev for testing — set it to a verified sender on your domain before going live.

All user-facing strings are English placeholders. See recipes/contact/README.md for where to swap copy.
